purpose: Recover lossless standalone headroom after new vehicle models and upstream detailed Perseverance integration exceeded the 16,000,000-byte gate.

encoding.header: The existing FIDBIN01 JSON header is lexed outside quoted strings. Decimal number text is replaced with # placeholders; one-byte lexeme widths retain order. Tokens are grouped by width and transposed by digit position. No numeric conversion, rounding or field removal occurs.
encoding.assets: The original FIDBIN01 binary asset tail is copied unchanged. Decode restores the original header and invokes the existing strict binary asset decoder.
encoding.compression: Standard gzip, Zopfli32 iterations; wide raw120 transport unchanged.
encoding.compatibility: FIDBIN01, plain JSON, raw120v1/wide, radix85 and legacy base64 decoders retained. Readable snapshot.json and generated legacy gzip8/radix85 snapshot-packed.js remain complete. Application gzip32/wide, CSS gzip5/raw120v1, Blob module import/revoke and unsupported-browser message remain.

validationRules: At most255 groups; positive unique widths and positive counts
Total grouped count equals order count
Every reference uses an existing group and consumes each token exactly once
Reconstructed lexemes match JSON decimal grammar
UTF-8 fatal decode; restored JSON parses
Existing binary asset prefix, reference, truncation and trailing-byte checks remain

screening.limitations: Screening only: no versioned production format or independent decoder adopted.

preservation: All53 dossiers,42 native references, original generated PNGs/masters, all native science/model/map/shape source files unchanged; no additional Tethys dossier or embedded asset. Existing source/frame/coverage/photometric/component/ranking limitations remain.
next: Tethys independent Saturn observer, masters/previews and additive native/local/observer integration within gate; more lossless headroom before larger batches. Remaining Solar System/craft/shape/calibration/ranking backlog ACTIVE.

verification.comparisonLimit: Previous failed build is historical, not a controlled same-snapshot Zopfli comparison; dynamic upstream snapshot inputs can change. The screening compares the same container with zlib9.
verification.browserScope: Chrome; other engines not independently tested
